14278.name: Convallaria Swordplay
desc: (Decision) Selects to cast Convallaria - Blooming Horizon or Convallaria - Windswept Blossom.

14249.name: Light of Convallaria
desc: (Support) The character gains 2 stacks of Free Will; all allies within 3 tiles gain △[ATK II and △Move I for 2 turns and recover 1 NRG.

14568.name: Brilliant Light
desc: (Aura) Reduces ATK and DEF of all enemies within 3 tiles of the character by 10%.

14570.name: Helping Hand
desc: (Passive) After performing an active attack, heals 1 ally in battle with the lowest HP for 40% of P.ATK plus M.ATK.

11991.name: Natural Sword Intent
desc: (Reaction) Before receiving an active single-target attack, performs a Preempt, dealing magical DMG equal to 100% P.ATK. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round. When defeated, if the character has 6 or more stacks of Free Will, consumes 6 stacks to trigger Unyielding and gains DMG Reduction IX for 1 turn. Can be triggered up to 1 time per battle.

4166.name: Battlefield Healing
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack, the DMG taken is decreased by 8%. Upon receiving an active attack, heals the ally with the lowest HP percentage within a 2-tile radius of the character by 100% of M.DEF.

11992.name: Guarding the Sword of Convallaria
desc: (Passive) If there are 2 or more allies within 2 tiles of the character, reduces DMG taken by 20%; after dealing physical DMG, converts 2 buffs from the target into random Level 2 Attribute Debuffs for 2 turns. When knocking the targets back, increases the knockback distance by 1 tile.

14247.name: Let's Advance Together
desc: (Passive) At the start of the turn, if there are 2 or more allies within 2 tiles of the character, all allies in range gain Co-Attack and Co-Defense for 2 turns.

11988.name: Sword - Dawnlight
desc: (Basic Attack) Attacks the designated target, dealing magical AoE DMG equal to 100% P.ATK.

11989.name: Sword - Dusk
desc: (Basic Attack) Attacks the designated target, dealing 110% physical AoE DMG and knocking back by 1 tile.

11984.name: Battle Flag of Convallaria Stands
desc: (Support) Instant Summons Battle Flag of Convallaria on the target tile and grants Co-Attack and Co-Defense to all allies within 5 tiles for 2 turns. After casting, the skill switches to For This World of Peace.

11993.name: Under the Flag of Convallaria
desc: (Leader's Aura) For all allies from Iria or Sword of Convallaria: Increases ATK by 10% and DEF by 20%; for each 1 ally from Iria or Sword of Convallaria in battle, increases DMG dealt by 3% and reduces DMG taken by 3%, up to 15%.

4011.name: Defense Boost
desc: (Support) Grants △ P.DEF to all allies within the target location and grants immunity to Defense Attribute Debuffs, lasting for 2 turns.

6367.name: Guard!
desc: (Support) Instant Teleports the Guard of the Princess in front of Inanna and grants sthe Guard Potential Burst for 2 turns. When the Guard is defeated, the skill summons a new Guard of the Princess.

4159.name: Protection of Light
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active single-target attack, the DMG taken is decreased by 30%. This effect can be activated 1 time per round.

4223.name: Light of Sanction
desc: (Magical DMG) Deals 70% AoE DMG to all enemies within a 2-tile radius of the target and dispel 2 buffs.

4512.name: Merciful Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% magical DMG and increases the effect of the next healing skill by 15%, lasting for 2 turns.

6369.name: Flight of the Princess
desc: (Healing) Inanna sacrifices 90% of her current HP to dispel all Debuffs, she gains Invisibility and △ Healing V, and expands the range of Trait skills by 2 times. She heals all allies within range. All effects last for 2 turns.

20824.name: Pack and Pick
desc: (Decision) Selects to use Watch Your Step or One on the House.

6498.name: Warrior of Frost
desc: (Passive) When the character is on Frosty tiles, decreases the DMG taken by 30% and increases Movement by 1 tile.

4036.name: Foot Sniping
desc: (Physical DMG) Single-target attack. Deals 110% DMG and inflicts ▽ Move II for 2 turns.

20868.name: Loner's Instinct
desc: (Reaction) Reduces DMG taken by the character and Icefang by 30%. When no other alleis are within 2 tiles, additionally reduces DMG taken by 20%.✦ Icefang gains Resolve; when triggered, recovers 100% of HP and gains Invisibility (lasting 1 turn) and DMG Reduction III (lasting 2 turns).

4140.name: Debilitation
desc: (Reaction) For every 1 tile the attacker moves before the character receives an active attack, the character takes 5% less DMG, up to 25%.

4489.name: Ice Attack
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% physical DMG and inflicts ▽ Move I on Healthy targets, lasting for 1 turn.

19647.name: Tundra Raider
desc: (Passive) Increases ATK by 10%. After attacking, can move 2 additional tiles.✦ Does not consume Movement when passing through Frosty tiles, up to 2 tiles per round.
